title: ALIBABA BANS CLAUDE CODE
description:
Alibaba just banned Claude Code!

The e-commerce giant has classified the AI programming tool as high-risk software due to security concerns and potential misuse. Anthropic is also tightening restrictions to prevent unauthorized access for users in China.

To fill the gap, Alibaba is pushing its employees toward Qoder, the company's own internal AI alternative. This shift underscores the growing tension between global AI development and corporate security protocols.

What do you think about this move?
